lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: are you busy?
I was resting.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Oh, that's nice!

lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: are the buildings in the Outpost

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: inspected at regular intervals?
Honestly... no. I've really had my hands full lately.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: The hospital has been getting low water pressure for the past few days,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: and now there's no water at all!
We're experiencing low water pressure in the dorm showers too.
Isn't having no water at the hospital a big deal?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehehe

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: But you DO realize

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: there's a big difference between no running showers

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: and a hospital not having any running water?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Clean water is essential for our patients.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: It's a very big deal.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Clean water is essential for our patients.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I'm just glad that you're not out in the field today.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: If you were injured during a mission

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: on a day without any running water,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: we'd have to delay the surgery.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: That could cause the wounds to fester.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: If that were to happen, we'd have to...
I'll go and check it out right now.
I'll get in touch with Mighty Tools right away.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Will you be able to fix it right away, Commander?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: There's no telling when our next patient will come in.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I'm hoping we can get this resolved as soon as possible T^T
I'll get in touch with Mighty Tools right away.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: That'd be great, hehe!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I feel like I can rest easy now.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I just hope we don't get any critical cases in the meantime.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Thanks for your help!
... I decided to inspect all the buildings in the Outpost as soon as possible.
